seed.name: susceptibility to respiratory infections associated with CD8alpha chain mutation

partners.mechanism_chain: CD8A (HGNC:2056) —DISRUPTS→ Susceptibility to respiratory infections (HP:0002234); C3 (HGNC:2497) —DISRUPTS→ Complement system activation (GO:0006955); Complement system activation (GO:0006955) —LEADS_TO→ Complement component 3 deficiency (HP:0003217); CD8A (HGNC:2056) —DECREASES→ Complement system activation (GO:0006955). Loss-of-function mutations in CD8A directly impair CD8+ T cell function, leading to susceptibility to respiratory infections. CD8+ T cells play a role in regulating immune responses, including those involving the complement system. A deficiency in C3 disrupts the complement cascade, leading to complement component 3 deficiency and impaired immune function. The proposed link is that impaired CD8+ T cell function due to CD8A deficiency can indirectly affect the efficiency or regulation of complement system activation, thus converging on a compromised immune response.

### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. complement component 3 deficiency  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.420)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-198933)

**Proposed mechanism:** CD8A (HGNC:2056) —DISRUPTS→ Susceptibility to respiratory infections (HP:0002234); C3 (HGNC:2497) —DISRUPTS→ Complement system activation (GO:0006955); Complement system activation (GO:0006955) —LEADS_TO→ Complement component 3 deficiency (HP:0003217); CD8A (HGNC:2056) —DECREASES→ Complement system activation (GO:0006955). Loss-of-function mutations in CD8A directly impair CD8+ T cell function, leading to susceptibility to respiratory infections. CD8+ T cells play a role in regulating immune responses, including those involving the complement system. A deficiency in C3 disrupts the complement cascade, leading to complement component 3 deficiency and impaired immune function. The proposed link is that impaired CD8+ T cell function due to CD8A deficiency can indirectly affect the efficiency or regulation of complement system activation, thus converging on a compromised immune response.

**How to falsify it:** The absence of any observed interaction or functional relationship between CD8A/CD8+ T cell function and the complement cascade in experimental models or human studies would falsify this hypothesis. Specifically, demonstrating that CD8+ T cell function is entirely independent of complement activation and C3 levels would refute the proposed overlap. _(variant: N/A)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding this mechanistic link could reveal synergistic therapeutic targets for managing infections in patients with either CD8A deficiency or C3 deficiency, potentially involving strategies to bolster complement function or enhance adaptive immune responses.

#### 2. obsolete blood group system, landsteiner-wiener  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.403)

Similarly, loss-of-function mutations in ICAM4 disrupt erythrocyte membrane protein complex organization, causing the Landsteiner-Wiener blood group phenotype. Both CD8A and ICAM4 are involved in the broader cytokine signaling pathway, which influences immune responses and red blood cell characteristics. Dysregulation of this pathway due to mutations in either gene can converge to manifest aspects of both diseases.
